notes.title: TILE release
notes.notes:
I am pleased to say that the TILE is now available in Steam!

Some information about current build.
It has only 15 levels but Ill make new 15 levels every 7-10 days.
Of course it will be free updates.

Good luck and have fun! ːanonymousː
